pages.text: Items that can be installed in machines to expand their performance or capabilities.$(br2)Upgrades include ones that improve processing speed, reduce FE consumption, increase FE storage, or expand the range of supported alchemy crafts.$(br2)The available upgrade types differ by machine.

pages.title: Speed Upgrade
pages.text: An upgrade that increases a machine's processing speed.

pages.title: Energy Efficiency Upgrade
pages.text: An upgrade that reduces a machine's FE consumption.

pages.title: Energy Capacity Upgrade
pages.text: An upgrade that increases the amount of FE a machine can store.

pages.title: Crafting Tool Upgrade
pages.text: An upgrade that expands the range of alchemy crafts a machine can handle.

pages.title: Tank Capacity Upgrade
pages.text: An upgrade that increases the amount of fluid a machine can store.

pages.title: Recipes and Handling
pages.text: Upgrades also have recipes in the $(l:machine/alchemical_reactor)Alchemical Reactor$(/l). Check JEI for ingredients such as $(l:machine/alchemical_base_paper)Alchemical Base Paper$(/l) and the required Crafting Tool tier.$(br2)Each machine's entry lists its supported upgrades. See $(l:machine/handling)Machine Handling$(/l) for removal conditions.
